headline: A vulnerable build-time dependency is refreshed; it is not part of the published package.
summary: browserslist, a transitive dependency of the fuzzing harness, is updated from 4.28.4 to 4.28.8 to clear GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g and GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx, both rated High. browserslist is a development and test dependency and is not included in the published package, so an installed @blamejs/pki carries none of it.
